scientific_scope: Observed finite scaling of the compiled incremental checker and its independent full-recheck reference on the same growing complete constitutive certificate property. This is neither an asymptotic theorem nor a claim about all neural systems.

growth_requirements: every generated neural node lies on the executed dependency chain consumed by the output
complete_obligations strictly grow across points and trace steps
at least one local cone transports a nonempty fragment set
at least one extended cone recalculates a nonempty fragment set

parameters.determinism: The generated family, schedule and both compiled checkers are deterministic. No random source is used.

uncertainty.failed_run_policy: Every timeout, memory excess, rejection or malformed output remains in raw_runs and makes the practical-gain verdict false for its point.

accounting.publication: Raw rows, separate incremental/full cumulative totals and per-step amortized totals are mandatory. Phase units are deterministic accounting quantities, not elapsed-time surrogates. Peak RSS is process-level and is not split between checker paths.

canonical_binary_format.description: Constructor tags use one byte, natural serials and integers eight bytes, and lists an eight-byte length followed by encoded elements. Semantic fragment tags and length fields use seven nine-byte headers; covered-future steps use sixteen bytes each.
canonical_binary_format.boundary: These byte counts measure the declared canonical readout, not Lean heap layout or process RSS.

practical_gain_rule.name: complete-property-cumulative-incremental-gain
practical_gain_rule.decision: Gain is true only if all five repetitions complete and median initialization-plus-incremental cumulative time is at most 80 percent of median initialization-plus-full-recheck cumulative time at every assessed point.

resource_budget.failure_policy: A timeout, resident-memory excess or checker rejection is published as an unfavorable observation within budget. It is not converted into falsity of a Lean theorem.

paired_execution.same_source: Both paths receive the same current CheckedAgent at every step.
paired_execution.same_target: Both paths receive the same ScalingReceivedArtifact.
paired_execution.same_property: Both paths build the same seven non-unit contract obligations and their semantic checksums must agree before an observation is emitted.
paired_execution.reference_independence: The complete reference checker reconstructs its target certificate and transition without receiving the incremental verdict, fragments or certificate.
paired_execution.continuation: Only the accepted incremental successor becomes the next exact source.

negative_control.required_outcome: nonzero exit before an accepted observation

interpretation_rules: All finite costs are observations, not Lean theorems.
No asymptotic form is inferred from five finite points.
A selection or reuse count is never reported as an economy.
An unfavorable result remains unfavorable and does not refute formal correction or equivalence.
The confirmatory result file is written once and never overwritten.
The frozen source commit must remain recoverable from Git.
